Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of fraud for which a report is established. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

Action.name: Action
Action.definition: Identifies the type of fraud reporting action. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

ReportingEntity.name: Reporting Entity
ReportingEntity.definition: Type of fraud reporting entity. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

CompromisedCredential.name: Compromised Credential
CompromisedCredential.definition: Identifies the type of cardholder credential that was compromised.

CardholderReportingDate.name: Cardholder Reporting Date
CardholderReportingDate.definition: Date of fraud as reported by the cardholder

ConfirmationReportingDate.name: Confirmation Reporting Date
ConfirmationReportingDate.definition: Date fraud was confirmed by the cardholder.

SubmitterCaseReference.name: Submitter Case Reference
SubmitterCaseReference.definition: Reference to the case as provided by the submitter.

MarketSegment.name: Market Segment
MarketSegment.definition: Type of market segment of confirmed fraud.

Arrest.name: Arrest
Arrest.definition: Indicates whether the party that committed fraud was arrested or not.

InvestigationStatus.name: Investigation Status
InvestigationStatus.definition: Investigation status at time of submission.
